history: Recommendation-eligible paid purchases with invoice_date strictly less than cutoff. Customer-item counts and recency use lifetime visible personal history. Quantity uses [cutoff-180 days,cutoff).
item: Purchaser counts use identified purchasers over [cutoff-30/180 days,cutoff). Last observed purchase uses all visible eligible paid purchases, including anonymous catalog evidence.
customer: All three customer aggregate features use [cutoff-180 days,cutoff). Lifetime invoice counts and recency from existing query snapshots are used separately for evaluation segmentation.
retrieval: Copy the frozen V1 candidate flags, scores and position unchanged. Popularity features deliberately duplicate the requested retrieval popularity scores; both are retained for this initial schema.
missing: Absent counts/quantities/source scores are zero. Never-purchased customer-item recency is NaN; ci_previously_purchased distinguishes it. Logistic: training-only median imputation with missing indicators, then query-weighted standard scaling. XGBoost: native missing branches. Both apply fixed log1p to listed nonnegative skewed columns.
ids: customer_id, query_id, SKU, cutoff and selected_source are metadata, never numeric model inputs. Features are selected in this exact order and stored as float32; labels/weights stay separate.
